title: Upper Airway Obstruction in Non-obese Patients With Snoring and Obstructive Sleep Apnea
brief_summary:
This study aims at :-

1. detecting the prevelance of snoring and OSA in non-obese patients
2. identify their diagnostic profile in order to provide proper management
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* older than 18 years
* patients complaining of snoring and obstructive sleep panea

Exclusion Criteria:

* chronic pulmonary disease ( COPD, Asthma ,IPF)
* Pregnancy
* sever cardiovascular disease ( unstable angina , sever arrhythmia , MI)
* chronic renal failure (CRF)
* neurological disorders
study_population: all patients refaired to outpatient clinic of Phoniatric Unit, Assiut University Hospital in duration of 1 year with history of snoring and history suggestive of obstructive sleep apnea will be included in this study
